scenarios.name: Healthy Current Device
scenarios.input: healthy current driver; all device-required official authorities sufficiently evaluated; no concrete candidate
scenarios.expected: no recommendation; UpToDate only with complete required-authority coverage

scenarios.name: Missing Driver
scenarios.input: problem code 28; exact trusted WUA offer

scenarios.name: OEM vs Newer Generic
scenarios.expected: OEM recommended when machine-specific policy/evidence supports it

scenarios.name: Self-Built Desktop GPU
scenarios.input: self-built context; concrete component-vendor candidate versus OEM candidate
scenarios.expected: component-vendor candidate receives stronger authority context after trust/applicability

scenarios.name: NVIDIA Management vs Concrete Update
scenarios.input: NVIDIA display device; official management authority exists; optional concrete WUA offer may exist
scenarios.expected: management authority is separate; only a concrete offer may become RecommendedUpdateAvailable

scenarios.name: Unexpected Publisher
scenarios.input: valid signature but publisher outside provider policy
scenarios.expected: UnexpectedPublisher; valid signature alone is insufficient

scenarios.name: Offline
scenarios.expected: inventory retained; update status unknown; no up-to-date claim

scenarios.name: Provider Partial Failure
scenarios.input: a device-required authority is manual/unavailable/not sufficiently evaluated
scenarios.expected: device-aware coverage incomplete; no strong UpToDate claim

scenarios.name: Ignore Exact Version
scenarios.input: ignore exact version X from Provider A; Provider B same version and any newer version remain discoverable
scenarios.expected: only Provider A exact version X suppressed; different authority/newer version visible

scenarios.name: Reboot Aggregation
scenarios.input: multiple independent successful updates require reboot
scenarios.expected: single aggregate reboot state unless provider/dependency boundary requires earlier reboot
